controles.affirmation: Croissance organique en deceleration pour la 4e annee consecutive (repete : resume, fondamental_interne #1 'quatre annees de deceleration continue', quantitatif #1 '4e annee de deceleration consecutive')
controles.verbatim_source: Historique organique (kpis-haut/PG.json, ORGANIC_GROWTH) : FY2022 7%, FY2023 7%, FY2024 4%, FY2025 2%, FY2026 1%. FY2023 est stable par rapport a FY2022, pas en deceleration. Les baisses consecutives sont FY2024, FY2025 et FY2026, soit trois annees.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire '3e annee de deceleration consecutive' et 'trois annees de deceleration continue depuis le pic de +7% de FY2022-FY2023'. Le reste de la phrase (+7% FY2022, +7% FY2023, +4% FY2024, +2% FY2025, +1% FY2026) est exact et peut rester tel quel.

controles.affirmation: P&G avait paye environ 200 M$ de tarifs IEEPA avant que la Cour supreme ne les invalide le 20 fevrier 2026, la moitie recuperee au T4 FY2026, le solde incertain
controles.verbatim_source: "On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that the tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) were invalid. The Company previously paid approximately $200 million in IEEPA tariffs that may be recoverable. During the three-month period ended June 30, 2026, the Company recognized recovery of half of this amount in its Consolidated Financial Statements." Citation de l'ATT exacte au mot pres.

controles.affirmation: Tarifs douaniers : 30 points de base d'impact net sur la marge brute FY2026
controles.verbatim_source: "30 basis points of net tariff impact from higher costs and recognized recoveries" - present mot pour mot dans le pont de marge brute du 10-K FY2026.

controles.affirmation: CA FY2026 +3% a 87,0 Mds $ : changes +2%, prix +1%, volumes et mix inchanges ; croissance organique +1%
controles.verbatim_source: "Net sales increased 3% to $87.0 billion in fiscal 2026 driven by favorable foreign exchange of 2% and pricing of 1%. Unit volume and mix were unchanged versus the prior year." ; "Organic sales, which exclude the impact of acquisitions and divestitures and foreign exchange, increased 1%."

controles.affirmation: Le +1% organique est le plus bas depuis 2018 et un retour au niveau de stagnation 2016-2018
controles.verbatim_source: kpis-haut/PG.json : FY2016 1%, FY2017 2%, FY2018 1%, FY2019 5%, FY2020 6%, FY2021 6%. FY2026 egale le plancher de FY2018.

controles.affirmation: Baby, Feminine & Family Care : 20,4 Mds $, 23% du CA, croissance organique de -1%
controles.verbatim_source: "Baby, Feminine & Family Care net sales increased 1% to $20.4 billion ... Excluding the impact of foreign exchange and acquisitions and divestitures, organic sales decreased 1%." Net sales $20,401 M$.
controles.correction_proposee: Precision mineure : le 10-K affiche lui-meme ce segment a 24% des ventes nettes dans son tableau de repartition (Item 1). 20 401/87 000 = 23,4% ; ecrire '24% du CA selon le 10-K' evite la divergence avec le document.

controles.affirmation: Marge brute -100 pb a 50,2%, marge operationnelle -160 pb a 22,7% ; pont marge brute mix -120, investissements produits -70, restructuration -60, tarifs -30, matieres premieres -20
controles.verbatim_source: "Gross margin 50.2 % 51.2 % (100) bps" ; "Operating margin 22.7 % 24.3 % (160) bps" ; pont detaille : "120 basis points of decline from unfavorable product mix, 70 basis points of product and packaging investments, 60 basis points of higher restructuring costs, 30 basis points of net tariff impact ..., 20 basis points of higher commodity costs".

controles.affirmation: Depenses publicitaires de 9,2 a 10,2 Mds $ (+11%), plus haut de la decennie (7,2 Mds $ en FY2016) ; SG&A +6% a 23,9 Mds $
controles.verbatim_source: "Advertising costs ... were $10.2 billion in 2026, $9.2 billion in 2025 and $9.6 billion in 2024." (+10,9%) ; "Total SG&A increased 6% to $23.9 billion ... due primarily to an increase in marketing spending". FY2016 a 7,2 Mds $ : kpis-haut/PG.json (AD_SPEND).

controles.affirmation: Resultat operationnel en recul de 703 M$ a 19,7 Mds $
controles.verbatim_source: "Operating income decreased $703 million, or 3%, to $19.7 billion" ; tableau "Operating income 19,748 20,451 (3) %".

controles.affirmation: Restructuration de 1,5 a 2,0 Mds $ avant impot sur deux ans, jusqu'a 7 000 postes non industriels d'ici fin juin 2027, dont plus de la moitie deja passee en FY2026
controles.verbatim_source: "The Company expects to incur approximately $1.5 to $2.0 billion in before-tax restructuring costs over a two-year period" ; "a plan for a reduction of up to 7,000 non-manufacturing overhead personnel by the end of fiscal 2027". Charges du programme en FY2026 : "incurred incremental restructuring charges of $903 million after tax under the program", soit plus de la moitie du bas de fourchette avant impot.

controles.affirmation: Effectifs a environ 104 000, -4% en un an, du fait de la restructuration
controles.verbatim_source: "approximately 104,000 employees, a decrease of 4% versus the prior year due to the ongoing restructuring program" - present mot pour mot.

controles.affirmation: Restructuration marches limites (Argentine, Nigeria) : 1,2 Md $ de charges apres impot
controles.verbatim_source: "...beginning in the three-month period ended December 31, 2023, through the three-month period ended September 30, 2024, were $1.2 billion after tax."

controles.affirmation: Parts de marche en baisse dans 3 segments sur 5 : Beauty -0,3, Grooming -0,4, Baby/Feminine/Family -0,2 ; Fabric & Home Care stable, Health Care +0,4
controles.verbatim_source: "Global market share of the Beauty segment decreased 0.3 points" ; "...Grooming segment decreased 0.4 points" ; "...Baby, Feminine & Family Care segment decreased 0.2 points" ; "...Fabric & Home Care segment was unchanged" ; "...Health Care segment increased 0.4 points". Les trois citations de l'ATT sont exactes.

controles.affirmation: Positions dominantes : plus de 60% du marche mondial des lames et rasoirs, environ 20% des soins capillaires
controles.verbatim_source: "Our global blades and razors market share is more than 60%, primarily behind our Gillette and Venus brands" ; "hair care market with about 20% global market share".

controles.affirmation: Walmart environ 16% des ventes totales sur 2026, 2025 et 2024 ; dix premiers clients environ 43% du CA
controles.verbatim_source: "Sales to Walmart Inc. and its affiliates represent approximately 16% of our total sales in 2026, 2025 and 2024" ; "Our top ten customers accounted for approximately 43% of our total net sales". Citations exactes.

controles.affirmation: Etats-Unis 41,7 Mds $ FY2026 vs 41,6 Mds $ FY2025 et 26,8 Mds $ FY2015, soit environ 48% du CA
controles.verbatim_source: kpis-haut/PG.json (US_REV) : FY2015 26,8 ; FY2025 41,6 ; FY2026 41,7. 41,7/87,0 = 47,9%. Le 10-K confirme que plus de la moitie des ventes est realisee hors Etats-Unis.

controles.affirmation: 16,0 Mds $ de benefice net, flux de tresorerie operationnel +10%, Core EPS 6,89 $ (+1%), dividende augmente 70 annees de suite
controles.verbatim_source: "Net earnings attributable to Procter & Gamble 16,046 15,974" ; "operating activities 19,556 17,817 10 %" ; "Core earnings per share 6.89 6.83 1 %" ; "has increased its dividend for 70 consecutive years since 1956".

controles.affirmation: 15,2 Mds $ rendus aux actionnaires (10,2 dividendes + 5,0 rachats) vs 15,8 Mds $ de FCF ajuste, soit 96% ; productivite du FCF de 100%
controles.verbatim_source: "Dividends to shareholders (10,232)" ; "Treasury stock purchases (5,028)" ; "Adjusted Free Cash Flow 15,835" ; "adjusted free cash flow ... was 100% in 2026". 15 260/15 835 = 96,4%.

controles.affirmation: Acquisition Thorne pour 3,8 Mds $, signee le 04/08/2026 ; dette totale 34,1 Mds $
controles.verbatim_source: "On August 4, 2026, the Company entered into an agreement to acquire Thorne, a premium wellness and supplement brand ... for $3.8 billion." Dette totale 34,14 Mds $ au Q4-2026 (kpis-haut/PG.json, DEBT_TOTAL).
